title: Proliferation-correlated expression
description: To determine how gene expression varies between fast and slow proliferating cells we developed a CFSE-based method to sort cells by intrapopulation heterogeneity in proliferation rate. We sorted cells by proliferation rate, as well as by the mitochondria dye TMRE, and performed mRNA-seq. Overall design: Sort high and low CFSE subpopulations
